sources: AGENTS.md instructions supplied in the task

findings.evidence: The new equations in ref/final_report/thesis_structure.tex:263 and 267 use \widehat\nu^{,2} and \widehat\sigma^{,2}. Page 13 of the compiled PDF extracts these as 'νb,2' and a comma before the superscript 2 on sigma, so the displayed estimators include an unintended comma rather than a clean squared symbol.
findings.fix: Remove the commas from the superscripts, e.g. use \widehat{\nu}^{2} and \widehat{\sigma}^{2}_{t+\Delta}, then rebuild and inspect page 13.
